preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Number of people in each test case is between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ai <= 2 * 10**5 for ai in ais)
preconditions.description: Sociability of each person is between 0 and 200,000.
Total number of people across all test cases does not exceed 200,000.
Total sum of sociabilities across all test cases and all people does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: Number of output lines for k equals the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= sum(ais) for k, ais in zip(ks, aiss))
postconditions.description: Maximum number of talks k for each test case is between 0 and the sum of sociabilities of all people in that test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(talks) == k for k, talks in zip(ks, talks_list))
postconditions.description: Number of talks listed for each test case equals the maximum number of talks k for that test case.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n and i != j for i, j in talks) for n, talks in zip(ns, talks_list))
postconditions.description: Each talk involves two distinct people within the range [1, n].
